corrections.fibonacci_anyons: Use SU(2)_3/Fibonacci-category wording; do not label Fibonacci anyons SU(2)_2.
corrections.pisot_exactness_boundary: The Pisot property does not by itself make floating-point arithmetic exact; exactness requires an explicit algebraic representation and exact algorithms.

gates.title: FoldGap receipt metric
gates.benchmark_spec: Compare exact emitted bit lengths for a declared baseline codec and a losslessly replayable folded codec under one accounting policy.
gates.shannon_boundary: Shannon entropy H(P) is an ensemble quantity for a declared source model. Per-execution receipts use measured code length and may optionally report self-information -log2 P(x) when P is explicit.
limitations: No codec/corpus benchmark is registered yet.
Kolmogorov complexity is not directly measurable and must not be reported as a receipt metric.
Model/decoder cost accounting must be identical across compared results.

gates.title: Orbit collapse beyond the stabilizer frontier
gates.reference_implementation: Stim for Clifford overlap plus an independent exact dense reference for tractable non-stabilizer instances
gates.benchmark_spec: Exhibit a provably non-stabilizer state/circuit family, represent it losslessly through an explicit group action/orbit coordinate, verify exact parity on tractable widths, and measure time/memory against meaningful references.
required_evidence: formal or independently checkable non-stabilizer witness
explicit group G and action G x S -> S
dense-reference differential suite on tractable widths
Stim differential suite on Clifford overlap
limitations: H3/H4/icosahedral terminology alone is not an implementation.
Reference simulator failure is not evidence of correctness.
No strict-extension witness is registered yet.

gates.title: Pisot-indexed transform versus cyclic QFT
gates.reference_implementation: Canonical cyclic QFT on matched finite workloads
gates.benchmark_spec: Define input/output spaces, index set, kernel, normalization, inverse and complexity; prove exact invertibility/unitarity if claimed; benchmark on a workload with declared Pisot/aperiodic structure against QFT/Fourier controls.
required_evidence: unitarity proof if exposed as a quantum transform
limitations: phi being a Pisot unit does not establish transform superiority.
Zeckendorf and Ostrowski numeration must not be conflated without a construction.
No comparative benchmark is registered yet.

gates.title: Definition and justification of 11D
gates.supported_domain: eleven real coordinates weighted by phi^-(i+1), i=0..10
gates.benchmark_spec: Ablate dimension around 11 under a predeclared criterion and report reconstruction error, FoldGap, runtime, memory, and downstream task quality. A theoretical significance claim additionally requires a derivation of why 11 is necessary or optimal.
gates.current_definition: 11D counts the eleven coordinates of the software-defined weighted ball B_phi^11 implemented by toe.poincare_golden_11d.
distinct_from: a proof that eleven is optimal
gates.ricci_boundary: A Ricci-flow claim requires an explicit metric g(t) and evolution equation; a scalar named ricci is insufficient.
gates.yang_mills_boundary: Finite/discrete spectral gaps must not be promoted to the continuum Yang-Mills mass-gap claim.
gates.poincare_boundary: The Poincare homology sphere and an 11D Poincare/hyperbolic ball are distinct spaces.
limitations: The implementation fixes dimension 11 but does not establish its necessity or optimality.
No derivation linking the 11D manifold dimension to the separate 11-qubit default is registered.
